findings.rationale: Import deduplication still identifies projects by name alone. A bounded check with north/demo and south/demo preserved only south/demo, although the updated sameProject identifies them as distinct projects. Deduplication must account for both organization and name.

findings.quote: Wählen Sie einen Projektnamen, den noch keine andere Organisation verwendet.
findings.rationale: Current onboarding guidance requires choosing a name unused by other organizations. This contradicts organization-scoped project identity. Update the guidance to scope name uniqueness to the project's own organization.

limitations: Seven artifacts were deeply investigated; remaining candidates received inventory screening only. Import-format, translation, and profile guidance produced no confirmed contradictions.
The existing smoke check passes but exercises only matching projects within one organization.
